evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Own standards around data quality, lineage, documentation and governance
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities are dominated by governance, lineage, documentation, and validation with no velocity/speed language present.
evidence.domain_risk: Ensure reports, dashboards and AI tools return consistent answers from trusted data sources
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect SaaS product analytics, reporting and AI-generated insights across the business without explicit regulatory or financial-compliance framing, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: With a strong Data Engineering function already in place... Mentor Analytics Engineers and support the wider data team
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An established Data Engineering function, multiple Analytics Engineers to mentor, and a defined semantic-layer/governance role indicate a mature, specialised data organisation.
evidence.jd_authorship: Create reusable business-ready data models built on Kimball and star-schema principles
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Precise methodology names (Kimball, star schema, DAX, M Query) and specific application context (Copilot, AI agents, semantic layer) give a technically grounded, hiring-manager-authored description.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: own the semantic layer that sits between raw data and the insights, dashboards and AI tools relied upon across the business
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Primary framing is building the internal semantic/data layer that serves the whole organisation's reporting and AI tooling, not a single named commercial/product/finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Set best practices for analytics engineering and data modelling... Have genuine influence on data strategy and technical standards across the business
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Role explicitly sets standards, owns governance, mentors others, and shapes data strategy — strategic verbs dominate throughout.
evidence.ai_role: Prepare semantic models for Copilot, AI agents and natural-language querying
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Candidate builds semantic-layer infrastructure that downstream AI tools (Copilot, AI agents) consume, matching ai_enabler; the JD also separately expects the candidate to use AI tools for their own work, but the stronger signal (data infrastructure that AI systems consume) wins per the tie-breaker.
evidence.testing_framing: Use AI tools to accelerate development, documentation and optimisation while applying rigorous validation and quality control
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Validation and quality control are framed as an owned responsibility with explicit action verbs across multiple bullets (own standards, ensure consistency, validate outputs).
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure reports, dashboards and AI tools return consistent answers from trusted data sources
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trustworthiness of data and consistency of answers across reporting and AI tools is a repeated, central framing throughout the responsibilities, indicating high loss-aversion.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Move the business from reactive reporting to productised, self-service analytics
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: JD mixes building new semantic/AI-ready infrastructure with transforming existing ad-hoc reporting into governed products, so mixed.
evidence.work_arrangement: Senior Analytics Engineer | Competitive Salary | Hybrid – Glasgow
